The role
For the Global Cloud Operations (GCO) Cloud Experience EMEA leadership team, we are looking for an experienced and highly trusted Senior Customer Officer.

In this strategic role, you will act as a key partner to the Regional Head of EMEA, helping to strengthen customer relationships, drive leadership priorities, improve organisational effectiveness, and ensure the successful execution of regional initiatives.

You will serve as the central point of coordination for strategic customer topics, executive engagements, escalations, regional governance, business performance reviews, and leadership communications. Working across market units, delivery organisations, account teams, support functions, and global leadership, you will help ensure that customer priorities, business objectives, and operational execution remain aligned.

Success in this role requires strong customer focus, executive presence, operational discipline, and the ability to bring together diverse stakeholders to drive outcomes across a dynamic and multicultural EMEA environment.

What you’ll do

Customer Outcomes and engagement

- Act as a trusted partner to the Regional Head of EMEA on strategic customer and business priorities.
- Plan and orchestrate executive customer engagements, leadership briefings, customer visits, and business reviews.
- Ensure alignment between customer expectations, regional priorities, and delivery execution.
- Prepare executive communications, customer updates, leadership presentations, talking points, and briefing materials.
- Bring leadership insights into key account planning and help prioritise customer engagement based on strategic relevance, customer needs, risk, and expected outcomes.
- Support customer transitions and delivery model alignment in close cooperation with the responsible account, commercial, delivery, and operational teams.
- Represent GCO Cloud Experience EMEA in internal and customer-facing executive forums.

Regional governance and strategic business operations

- Create visibility for leadership through high-quality reporting, structured communication, and actionable management insights.
- Support the execution of strategic initiatives and transformation programmes across EMEA.
- Monitor business performance and help identify risks, dependencies, decision requirements, and opportunities.
- Ensure management decisions, actions, and commitments are documented, tracked, and executed.
- Author and maintain the regional strategy paper, annual priorities, and key leadership narratives.
- Coordinate workforce planning, headcount tracking, hiring activities, budget-related topics, and organisational initiatives in collaboration with the relevant functions.
- Support the coordination of customer transitions involving PC3, EC3, hybrid, legacy, CAS, and related delivery scenarios.

Your profile

- Professional experience in customer success, delivery of cloud services, strategy and operations,  business operations management, or a comparable role in a complex international environment.
- Proven ability to support senior executives and leadership teams in setting priorities, preparing decisions, and translating strategic direction into executable plans
- Strong customer orientation with experience in strategic customer engagements, escalations, executive communication, and senior stakeholder management.
- Good understanding of enterprise cloud operating models and customer service delivery; knowledge of SAP, SAP S/4HANA, private cloud, hyperscaler environments, or Global Cloud Operations is a strong advantage.
- Demonstrated strength in governance, performance reporting, workforce and budget coordination, decision tracking, change management, and turning complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
- Excellent English communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and influencing skills, combined with strategic thinking, and the ability to work effectively across countries, cultures, functions, and seniority levels; additional EMEA languages are an advantage.

What success looks like

- Strategic customers experience consistent executive engagement and strong follow-through.
- Escalations are managed proactively with clear ownership, transparent communication, and disciplined action tracking.
- Regional leadership operates with greater transparency, alignment, and execution discipline.
- Customer insights influence strategic decisions and operational improvements.
- Key EMEA initiatives are executed effectively and deliver measurable business outcomes.
- Market units, delivery teams, account teams, and regional leadership collaborate effectively around customer priorities.
- The Regional Head and EMEA leadership team can focus on strategic decisions because the right governance, communication, and execution mechanisms are in place.

Are you looking to own the customer-facing experience for JetBrains products, from how individuals and organizations buy and manage software to how licensing and entitlements work behind the scenes?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll lead the strategy for BAD (Business Application Development) Product. You’ll tackle the complex web of purchases, subscriptions, organization administration, and usage-based services, making sure our customers have a smooth, coherent experience every step of the way.

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, QA, and BAD Platform, as well as Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams. You’ll have the autonomy to drive product discovery, validate hypotheses through data and experimentation, and define the long-term vision for our licensing and administration ecosystem.

Day to day, you will:

- Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for BAD Product systems.
- Uncover user friction through customer research, support data, telemetry, and feedback from internal teams.
- Map and improve end-to-end customer journeys covering purchasing, subscriptions, licensing, and administration.
- Identify gaps, overlaps, and inconsistencies across sub-systems to build a clear, unified user experience.
- Partner with engineering, design, analytics, and QA from early discovery through launch and continuous iteration.
- Define and track key product metrics for adoption, conversion, and support demand.
- Communicate product direction, trade-offs, and progress clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

- An ownership mindset, taking responsibility for outcomes, not just task completion.
- A clear focus on underlying problems and desired outcomes rather than immediate feature requests.
- Comfort with technical complexity, trade-offs, and systems thinking.
- A preference for quality, long-term sustainability, and user trust over short-term fixes.
- The ability to make grounded decisions using customer research, analytics, and experimentation.
- Strong collaboration skills across multi-disciplinary teams and distinct business areas.

What you’ll need

- A proven track record of managing technically complex SaaS, enterprise, or B2B product areas end to end.
- Hands-on experience driving product discovery, user research, and roadmap prioritization.
- Experience navigating complex customer journeys, multi-team dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.
- Experience making data-informed decisions using telemetry, product metrics, and experimentation.
- The ability to work comfortably alongside engineering teams on technical details, APIs, data models, and system integrations.
- Fluency in English.

What success looks like

In practice, success means building a licensing and administration experience that feels seamless to the user and resilient under the hood. You'll bring clarity to ambiguous systems, simplify fragmented customer flows, and establish reliable product metrics. Ultimately, you succeed by removing friction for millions of developers and admins, allowing them to focus on their actual work.

Why join JetBrains?

- Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
- Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
- Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
- Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to read your application.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

Materials Analysis is an Oxford Instruments Business Unit that manages our Electron Microscopy and Mechanical Microscopy products, Atomic Force Microscopes, Raman Microscopes and Benchtop NMR Products. We are part of the wider Oxford Instruments Group that also includes Andor Technology, NanoScience, Plasma Technology and X-Ray Technology. With a sixty-year history, and fourteen Queen’s Awards for Enterprise, our world-class products and technologies are helping our customers to address the greatest challenges of the 21st century.

The Role

We are looking for a Team Lead of Project Engineering to lead our Product Engineering function and act as a key interface between R&D, Production, Operations and the wider business. This is a hands?on leadership role combining product engineering, compliance and quality management, ensuring robust release processes and high?quality, compliant products.

You will be responsible for structuring and running the “back?end” of R&D: establishing processes, managing documentation, guiding the team, and ensuring smooth transitions from development to production.

This is a highly visible on?site role within a collaborative R&D and production environment.

Key Responsibilities Product Engineering Leadership
• Lead and develop the Product Engineering team
• Own and manage Product Engineering processes, including: Design freezes, Pilot series, Iterative improvement loops, Process freezes and volume gates
• Coordinate cross?functionally with R&D, Operations, Supply Chain and Product Management to support smooth product launches
• Clarify technical issues, prioritise tasks and resources, and ensure delivery against timelines and cost targets
• Ensure transparent communication on technical feasibility, risks, timelines and costs
• Own BOM management and continuous improvement
• Drive continuous product improvements after process freeze
• Identify and close process gaps between R&D and Operations
• Oversee realisation of SCS solutions, coordinating technical planning, construction and production
• Facilitate lessons?learned sessions after major SCS projects to determine future productisation
• Contribute to strategic initiatives such as: ERP and PLM development, Modularisation and variant management, Digitalisation of technical processes and workflows
• Manage Product Engineering?related change and improvement processes across multiple departments

Compliance
• Coordinate compliance activities for all new products through pilot series
• Manage compliance challenges and escalations (e.g. customer?specific requirements)
• Organise and maintain compliance documentation
• Support CE and EMC/EMV?related activities
• Coordinate contributions from other departments where required
• Act as the internal interface to compliance experts (expert knowledge remains with the central compliance team)
• Support release processes requiring external compliance sign?off

Quality Management
• Take overall responsibility for internal production quality standards
• Establish systems to track, analyse and evaluate test and measurement data
• Ensure quality processes support production rather than create additional burden (smart, pragmatic tooling and workflows)
• Coordinate and support production in case of quality issues
• Act as R&D’s interface to the ISO responsible person, supporting: Process mapping and version control, Identification and closure of R&D process gaps in line with ISO requirements
• Drive the completion of documentation gaps within Product Engineering and coordinate closure across R&D

What We’re Looking For
• Strong experience with high?tech products in a product or project engineering environment
• Proven people leadership and team coordination experience
• Highly organised, structured, and pragmatic problem?solver
• Strong understanding of quality, compliance, release and industrialisation processes
• Background or training in Six Sigma, quality management or similar methodologies
• Experience working towards or within ISO?compliant environments
• Ability to balance “what is required” with a focus on delivering a truly excellent product
• Confident communicator, comfortable operating at the interface between engineering and the wider organisation
• Strong project management skills
• Willingness to attend training and further develop expertise in ISO, compliance and quality

Note to candidate: Please submit applications in English, with your CV and covering letter and your Referenzen. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial Teams call, with the opportunity to learn more about the role.

jobs.description:
Your responsibilitiesThe New Opportunities Development Team scouts opportunities for EIT Health to engage in collaborative project proposals, diversifying the organisation’s portfolio of grant-funded projects. The Team leads efforts to build strong proposals and bids across a variety of funding instruments, ensuring opportunities are pursued, structured and developed from early ideas into concrete concepts with a high chance of award by the relevant funding bodies

EIT Health delivers a portfolio of collaborative projects, supported by diversity of funding sources. To ensure a steady pipeline of new opportunities EIT Health is recruiting a Senior Manager, New Opportunities Development. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues in the New Opportunities Development Unit under the Director of Community and Stakeholders Engagement and transversally with relevant business units at EIT Health that have potential to engage in EU funded projects. This role is not about inventing or delivering the underlying innovation itself, but about designing the structures, partnerships and funding pathways that allow others' innovations to be developed, tested and scaled through European collaborative projects. You will scout and prioritise funding opportunities (EU or national grants, philanthropic foundations, tenders), design new project applications, manage the end-to-end proposal development process, ensuring alignment with business needs target financing schemes.
If you have a track record of orchestrating securing EU funded projects, as a consortium architect or proposed lead, experience in raising philanthropic funding, and the drive to turn bold ideas into concrete implementation plans, we want to hear from you.
Role responsibilities:
• Proactively scout for funding opportunities (European, national, private philanthropic) in collaboration with the relevant internal delivery and support teams and EIT Health’s ecosystem engagement staff.
• Support the prioritisation of EIT Health’s and its partners’ engagement in different opportunities, keeping a consolidated map of the funding pipeline and facilitating the relevant internal endorsement and approval processes for participation in grant applications.
• Lead and coordinate proposal development with different functions in the organisation, including project conceptualisation, proposal writing, budget preparation and consortium partner engagement.
• Act as the connective layer between innovators, funders and implementing teams, ensuring ideas are translated into fundable, well-structured project frameworks.
• Collaborate with external stakeholders (such as higher education institutions, research agencies, small and large companies, policy bodies, network organisations, etc.) to build collaborative consortia for joint proposals and bids, including leading on negotiations and alignment on roles, responsibilities and resources.
• Plan the transfer of awarded project proposals to the implementing units, including via administrative and contracting support.
• Maintain repositories, logs and dashboards of the opportunities pipeline and raise internal visibility of proposals under development.
• Collaborate closely with all business units at EIT Health to secure buy-in in proposals in the pipeline (asset management, profit growth, delivery, communications, stakeholder engagement, operations and finance functions) within the wider team and the overarching EIT Health organisation.
• Support post-project review, for internal learning.

Your skills & knowledge
• Master's degree or higher in business administration, innovation management, life sciences, engineering, or a related field, or substantial relevant experience.
